title: Saturday matinee westerns
blurb: John Wayne before he was John Wayne, Errol Flynn on the Santa Fe Trail, and the B-westerns that filled every Saturday afternoon for thirty years.

films.note: Wayne as a gunfighter nursed by a Quaker girl. He produced it himself and it shows in the best way.
Wayne and Maureen O'Hara brawl through a whole town. The mud-slide fight.
Errol Flynn and Olivia de Havilland, with Ronald Reagan as George Custer.
Gregory Peck holds a fort with the men who hate him. Tight, mean, underrated.
Wayne in the Oklahoma oil rush. Republic Pictures at full budget, for once.
Randolph Scott keeps the peace between cattlemen and homesteaders. Meat and potatoes, done right.
Wayne at twenty-seven in a Lone Star quickie. Fifty-four minutes, one horse, done.
Retired Texas Rangers clean up one more town. Walter Brennan, Pat O'Brien, Chill Wills.
Randolph Scott solves murders at a radium mine. A western with a whodunit inside it.
Two cattlemen build a Texas empire and fall out over it. Richard Dix, Preston Foster.
